svg.title: Step 9 mockup 10: a data box's settings and the layout gallery
svg.text: 10 · A data box's settings, with sample data, and the LAN board in the layout gallery
Screen studio → Zones and layouts → Main hall: the zone editor (master–detail, a fixed column) with the Top games box picked. On the phone, the layout gallery as a tile grid (amendment 3).
Use case: the organiser sets up a data box before the bot runs, and picks the LAN board for a zone.
